<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="araxxor-necromancy" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Araxxor: Necromancy</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/w4CtXQCKIY.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><em><nowiki>Note: a </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>Table of Contents</nowiki></em><em><nowiki> can be found in the pinned messages for this channel.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is an </nowiki><strong><nowiki>advanced guide</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#araxxor-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=Ae9Q2oND5zxYU4ILNbI5 <nowiki>Necromancy preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FAe9Q2oND5zxYU4ILNbI5.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Araxxor is desired, wearing a ranged weapon until Araxxor has spawned is required</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ It is recommended to have the </nowiki><em>[https://runescape.wiki/w/NopeNopeNope <nowiki>NopeNopeNope</nowiki>]</em><nowiki> perk from Player Owned Farms active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1" alt="kalgscroll" title="kalgscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff from your familiar</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Araxxor takes a few seconds to clear vulns on phase 1-3, making vuln bombs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> usable on all phases</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="top-path"><ins><nowiki>Top Path</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1"><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After Araxxor has spawned, equip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1" alt="omniguard" title="omniguard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809230573441064.png?v=1" alt="soulboundlantern" title="soulboundlantern" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Apply </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1143642262165790911.png?v=1" alt="haunted" title="haunted" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and build to 5 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and 12 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not attack the boss other than to apply the debuffs and obtain stacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This phase is timegated so it can be used to set yourself up for phase 2 while you deal damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2"><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ At 59 seconds use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Trigger player movement on every tick along with your mobility abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clicking on an enlarged minimap may be helpful in facilitating movement and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> placements across the path</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be executed when web burn reads 99%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3"><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="middle-path"><ins><nowiki>Middle Path</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1_1"><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ No special setup. Just dps araxxor down to &lt;5k hp</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2_1"><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Just dps araxxor down to &lt;5k hp</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ When you go to the top of the ramp, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → filler → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1" alt="commandghost" title="commandghost" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ End this phase with at least 70% adrenaline</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3_1"><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + run to the edge of the arena near Phase 4 → (tc) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at any time in this phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="bottom-path"><ins><nowiki>Bottom Path</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1_2"><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ No special setup. Just dps araxxor down to &lt;5k hp</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2_2"><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ On Phase start </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → filler → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1" alt="commandghost" title="commandghost" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During the charge you want to do </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1" alt="kalgscroll" title="kalgscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + spam click your minimap</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ End this phase with at least 70% adrenaline</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3_2"><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ (tc) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at any time in this phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
